recordDescription: Return each distinct aquatic species/tissue/preparation/condition record with a reported biochemical amino-acid composition (hydroxyproline, proline or explicitly printed imino total), raw-tissue colorimetric hydroxyproline content, or isolated-collagen denaturation temperature. Keep raw tissue separate from extracted collagen and retain each separately measured fraction. Exclude author-computed sequence composition, bone maturation endpoints, raw-tissue shrinkage, isolated-extract purity/content assays, collagen yields or total extraction amounts, non-aquatic controls, cross-species averages, cited-only literature, procedural temperatures, spectroscopic peak positions and unlabelled curve estimates. A melting or broad endothermic peak is not denaturation temperature. Do not compute imino sums, unit conversions or missing standard deviations. Do not split analytical replicates into separate specimens. Return [] when there are no eligible records.

schemaNodes.name: year
schemaNodes.description: Journal issue/publication year, distinguish earlier online publication.

schemaNodes.name: sample_records
schemaNodes.description: Return each distinct aquatic species/tissue/preparation/condition record with a reported biochemical amino-acid composition (hydroxyproline, proline or explicitly printed imino total), raw-tissue colorimetric hydroxyproline content, or isolated-collagen denaturation temperature. Keep raw tissue separate from extracted collagen and retain each separately measured fraction. Exclude author-computed sequence composition, bone maturation endpoints, raw-tissue shrinkage, isolated-extract purity/content assays, collagen yields or total extraction amounts, non-aquatic controls, cross-species averages, cited-only literature, procedural temperatures, spectroscopic peak positions and unlabelled curve estimates. A melting or broad endothermic peak is not denaturation temperature. Do not compute imino sums, unit conversions or missing standard deviations. Do not split analytical replicates into separate specimens. Return [] when there are no eligible records. Copy every free-text value verbatim as printed in the source, using the exact term or abbreviation the paper uses for this sample; do not paraphrase, expand, abbreviate or normalize it. Controlled values (material_class, collagen_type_certainty, analyte, basis, outcome) keep their listed vocabulary.

children.name: species
children.description: Source-reported scientific name, or the printed source name when a scientific name is absent. Do not infer a binomial.

children.name: tissue
children.description: The source-reported anatomical material for this specimen. Do not join results from different tissues or infer a more specific tissue.

children.name: preparation
children.description: Printed preparation/fraction identifier, e.g. ASC/PSC/major/minor. Null when the source has no label. Keep separate fraction columns. Do not use inferred collagen type as identity.

children.name: material_class
children.description: isolated_collagen for extracted collagen and its separately prepared fractions, even when purity or collagen type is uncertain; raw_tissue for a raw-material hydroxyproline assay. Keep each observation with its actual owner.

children.name: condition
children.description: Distinct specimen treatment condition only if it defines a separately reported sample. Null otherwise; analytical measurement conditions belong to observations.

children.name: collagen_type
children.description: Reported collagen type(s) as source terms, with uncertain types left uncertain. Null if not reported.

children.name: collagen_type_certainty
children.description: Use reported, tentative, or unresolved according to the source claim; null if no type claim.

children.name: extraction_method
children.description: Preparation-specific reported extraction method. Null for raw tissue/sequence-only or when unresolved.

children.name: amino_acids
children.description: All explicitly reported target biochemical composition observations owned by this specimen; raw-tissue colorimetric hydroxyproline is eligible. Keep printed amino composition distinct from raw-tissue dry-weight content. Exclude sequence calculations and isolated-extract purity/content concentrations. [] when none.

children.name: analyte
children.description: Target analyte only.

children.name: basis
children.description: chemical_assay for amino-acid composition; dry_weight for raw-tissue hydroxyproline content reported per dry mass. Preserve units and their denominator.

children.name: value
children.description: Printed amount or mean only. Do not derive a sum, divide or convert units.

children.name: stdev
children.description: Printed standard deviation only. Null if no SD; no invented zero.

children.name: unit
children.description: Printed unit including its denominator. Retain percent versus residues per 1000 versus dry-weight basis.

children.name: thermal_data
children.description: Source-reported finite numeric isolated-collagen denaturation temperatures only. Return [] when no finite denaturation temperature is reported; do not emit a not_detected observation. Exclude raw-tissue shrinkage, maturation, processing temperatures, generic endothermic or melting peaks, spectroscopic peaks and cited-only results. [] when none.

children.name: parameter
children.description: A temperature explicitly identified as isolated-collagen denaturation, not any other thermal endpoint.

children.name: method
children.description: Reported assay method for this collagen denaturation measurement, such as circular dichroism, viscosity or differential scanning calorimetry. Null when unstated.

children.name: medium
children.description: Reported measurement medium only; null when unstated.

children.name: sample_state
children.description: Reported sample state for this assay only.

children.name: condition
children.description: Reported assay conditions including concentration/heating rate where available. Do not copy conditions from a different assay.

children.name: outcome
children.description: measured for a printed finite isolated-collagen denaturation temperature. Return no observation when this endpoint is not reported.

children.name: value
children.description: Printed finite numeric isolated-collagen denaturation temperature only. Exclude process temperatures, test limits, melting peaks, ND and other thermal endpoints.

children.name: stdev
children.description: Printed SD of this endpoint, else null.

children.name: unit
children.description: Printed endpoint unit. Do not convert temperatures.
